facts.fact: Threads reached 350 million monthly active users by June 2025, according to the vendor's guide.
facts.quote: Threads reached **350 million monthly active users** by June 2025, while Bluesky had a daily audience of **4.1 million**.

facts.fact: Bluesky had a daily audience of 4.1 million, according to the vendor's guide.
facts.quote: while Bluesky had a daily audience of **4.1 million**.

facts.fact: X had about 132 million mobile daily active users, per the figures the vendor's table reports for June 2025.
Bluesky had more than 37 million registered accounts, per the figures the vendor cites for June 2025.
facts.quote: **More than 37 million registered accounts** and **4.1 million daily users**

facts.fact: Bluesky's daily audience grew 372.5% year over year, according to TechCrunch reporting that the vendor cites.
facts.quote: It also reports that Bluesky’s daily audience grew **372.5% year over year**

facts.fact: X's mobile daily figure declined 15.2% year over year, according to TechCrunch reporting that the vendor cites.
facts.quote: while X’s mobile daily figure declined **15.2% year over year**.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide cites TechCrunch as reporting Threads at 350 million monthly active users, X at roughly 132 million mobile daily active users, and Bluesky at more than 37 million registered accounts alongside 4.1 million daily users.
facts.quote: notes Threads’ **350 million monthly active users**, X’s roughly **132 million mobile daily active users**, and Bluesky’s **more than 37 million registered accounts**

facts.fact: Standard comparisons, as cited by the vendor, describe X as strongest for news, B2B, and politics, Threads as more lifestyle-oriented, and Bluesky as concentrated in technology, media, and the open-web community.
facts.quote: Standard comparisons describe **X as strongest for news, B2B, and politics; Threads as more lifestyle-oriented; and Bluesky as concentrated in technology, media, and the open-web community**.

facts.fact: Meta opened Threads advertising to all eligible advertisers globally in April 2025.
facts.quote: Meta opened Threads advertising to all eligible advertisers globally in April 2025.

facts.fact: Threads advertising placement was enabled by default for new Advantage+ and Manual campaigns, and advertisers could use an inventory filter to manage sensitive content next to ads.
facts.quote: The placement was enabled by default for new Advantage+ and Manual campaigns, and advertisers could use an inventory filter to manage sensitive content next to ads.

facts.fact: A benchmark of 10.2 million posts published during 2024 found a 6.25% median engagement rate on Threads.
facts.quote: A benchmark of **10.2 million posts published during 2024** found a **6.25% median engagement rate on Threads**

facts.fact: In the same benchmark of 10.2 million posts published during 2024, X had a 3.60% median engagement rate, per the cited third-party Buffer data.
facts.quote: compared with **3.60% on X**, a **73.6% relative advantage** for Threads.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its TV campaigns can start at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Campaigns can start at **$30 a day**, with automatic pacing capped at the advertiser’s chosen spend.

facts.fact: Adwave states its AI-created broadcast-ready TV spots can be placed across more than 100 premium channels, including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: with placement across more than **100 premium channels**, including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
